svg.text: Main loop – press MODE for the next mode
f and f + shift, 500 ms each
MODE (back to OFF; without CALLSIGN: FSK → OFF)
hold MODE 1 s: FSK shift setting (output keeps running)
cursor on the 10 kHz digit, ▲ pressed
change the digit above the cursor (19 → 20), hold to repeat
move the cursor to the next digit (wraps around)
save the FSK shift (also works in the shift setting)
in FSK: open / close the FSK shift setting
VAR only: ±1 Hz, hold for 10 Hz steps (about 100 Hz/s)
